snippet.title: Yume Nikki Fangame playthrough - KOU ver. 0.02 bugfix
snippet.description:
Content warning:
- blood, gore, and violence
- depiction of a vehicle accident
- bright colors
- body horror
- jumpscares

Read more about this fangame: https://ynfg.yume.wiki/Kou_(%E7%B5%9E)_
Download: https://ux.getuploader.com/mugen_infernum/download/36
Download (bugfix patch): https://ux.getuploader.com/mugen_infernum/download/38

Okutsuki's part
0:00 Starting their part
2:28 Getting Reed Boat and Marine EFFECTS
4:31 Getting Tree Moss EFFECT
6:17 Getting Silver Fox EFFECT
8:42 Getting Dwarf and Face Cloth EFFECTS, Combining Marine and Face Cloth effects, Getting Right Eye and Left Eye EFFECTS, Getting caught by a chaser
15:17 Getting Dragon Flute EFFECT, trying a few times to trigger the Dream-in-Dream
18:34 Entering the Dream-in-Dream, Visiting Mawatsuki, Getting caught by the chaser protecting her, re-entering the Dream-in-Dream, Getting Disaster EFFECT
22:22 Reading effect names in the real world

Nawatsuki's part
23:19 Switching to Nawatsuki, starting her part
24:26 Getting Small Boat and Horns EFFECTS
26:00 Getting Sailor Uniform EFFECT, Combining Small Boat and Sailor Uniform effects, Getting Sunflower EFFECT
27:28 Getting Rabbit, Dwarf, and White Paste EFFECTS, Combining White Paste effect with Horns and Rabbit effects
30:40 Getting Oinari EFFECT
31:28 Reading effect names in the real world

Okutsuki's part
31:57 Switching back to Okutsuki, Going back to the Face Cloth effect location and looking at a mirror with all effects
